title: Nether Furnace
description: This mod adds a nether-furnace that is fueled only by a bucket of lava and runs for a very long time (2 hours, 46 minutes and 40 seconds). The mod is still raw, but it is constantly evolving!
body:
This mod adds a nether-furnace that is fueled only by a bucket of lava and runs for a very long time (2 hours, 46 minutes and 40 seconds). The mod is still raw, but it is constantly evolving!
This is the first mod from the creator of KOPIOH, I hope you like the mod!
